assessment: The study examines the mechanism of hepatic FGF21 using trangenic and over-expression models to show that it limits hepatic lipotoxicity, inflammation and fibrogenesis. They provide convincing data to support the notion that FGF21 blocks hepatic lipid influx and accumulation through combined endocrine and autocrine signaling, respectively, which prevent Kupffer cell activation, and scar-associated macrophages to inhibit fibrogenesis.
